title: Plastidic Mitochondrial Coupling & Root-Zone Dissolved Oxygen (DO) Respiration Dynamics
description: PhD study on root ATP synthase electron transport, micro-nano bubble dissolved oxygen (DO) saturation (>8.5 mg/L), and pyruvate dehydrogenase activation in hydroponics.
image_caption: Micro-nano bubble oxygenation generator connected to deep water culture (DWC) nutrient solution reservoir.
overview: Substrate hypoxia (DO < 3.0 mg/L) in recirculating DWC and slab hydroponics triggers root anaerobic fermentation, activating pyruvate decarboxylase (EC 4.1.1.1) and leading to ethanol accumulation and ATP depletion. This paper demonstrates that injecting micro-nano oxygen bubbles to maintain root-zone DO at supersaturated levels (9.5–11.0 mg/L at 21.0°C) elevates root cellular ATP levels by +42%, boosting active H⁺-ATPase proton pump activity across the root plasma membrane and accelerating nitrate (NO3⁻) symport transport by +26%.

climate_strategy.strategy: Install inline micro-nano bubble oxygen generators maintaining DO > 9.0 mg/L continuously. Keep nutrient solution temperature at 19.5°C–21.0°C to optimize oxygen gas solubility.

crop_steering.intro: Root-zone oxygenation and solution temperature steering matrix.

fertigation.intro: Anion/Cation uptake optimization under aerobic root respiration.
fertigation.vegetative_phase: Maintain active H⁺-ATPase pump driving NO3⁻ / H⁺ cotransport using Calcium Nitrate [PubChem CID 24963] and Ammonium Nitrate [PubChem CID 22985].
fertigation.generative_phase: Prevent root microbial oxygen competition by sterilizing recirculating solution via UV-C irradiation (254nm).

references.text: Micro-nano bubble oxygenation enhances root aerobic respiration and nutrient uptake in hydroponic crops.
